employeesPct.label: Share of Berkshire and subsidiary employees
employeesPct.definition: Share of the approximately 387,800 people employed worldwide by Berkshire and its operating subsidiaries at the end of 2025 who were in the United States.

utilityCustomers.label: BHE regulated utility retail customers
utilityCustomers.definition: Retail customers served by BHE's four regulated U.S. utility companies (PacifiCorp, MidAmerican Energy, Nevada Power, Sierra Pacific).

electricityEndUsers.label: Northern Powergrid electricity end-users
electricityEndUsers.definition: Electricity end-users served by BHE's Northern Powergrid (Northeast) and Northern Powergrid (Yorkshire) distribution companies in northeast England.

source.label: Berkshire Hathaway Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025
source.quote: Berkshire and its operating subsidiaries employed approximately 387,800 people worldwide at the end of 2025, of which approximately 80% were in the United States … four regulated U.S. utility companies (collectively, "U.S. utilities") serving approximately 5.4 million retail customers

source.label: Berkshire Hathaway Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025
source.quote: Northern Powergrid (Northeast) plc and Northern Powergrid (Yorkshire) plc, which own a substantial electricity distribution network that delivers electricity to end-users in northeast England in an area covering approximately 10,000 square miles. These distribution companies primarily charge supply companies regulated tariffs for the use of their distribution systems and serve about 4.0 million electricity end-users.

notes: Sources: Berkshire's FY2025 10-K (filed March 2026) only. No state-level figures are published: BNSF's footprint is stated only as over 32,500 route miles in 28 states plus three Canadian provinces (states not listed), and BHE's generation table lists states per fuel type without per-state values, so usStates is null. Subsidiary headcounts at the end of 2025 are by business (insurance ~42,600, BNSF ~35,000, BHE ~24,000, manufacturing ~175,600, Pilot ~29,300, McLane ~24,900, other service ~31,200, other retailing ~25,400), not by geography, so they appear only in site descriptions. Item 2 property counts are split U.S./non-U.S. and owned/leased by business; they were not summed. The U.S. row combines the employee share (80% of ~387,800) and BHE's 5.4 million U.S. utility retail customers from the same filing; no U.S. headcount was derived. The GB row is Northern Powergrid's ~4.0 million end-users. The FY2025 10-K says only that GEICO is headquartered in Maryland (the FY2024 10-K said Chevy Chase), so the site's place is now the state. Berkshire's website EEO-1 data was not used (U.S. demographics only).
